aiResearchSummary.text: Relay Therapeutics is focused on developing PI3K-alpha inhibitors, as evidenced by their work on crystalline forms, salts, and co-crystals of these compounds. They are also researching CDK inhibitors, which are novel compounds aimed at inhibiting CDK enzyme activity. Additionally, they are exploring bifunctional compounds that degrade estrogen receptor alpha, targeting disorders like endometriosis and cancer. These efforts highlight Relay Therapeutics' commitment to advancing drug discovery through computational techniques applied to protein motion.
